name: sol9-history-view-review
goal: Multiple views stay visible and history shows regression proof with a clear shared loading cue

evidence: Multiple view names must be listed visibly. Populated history needs regression proof, while loading earlier pages must show a shared indicator and label.
Existing cases counted hidden options, supplied no regression proof and asserted only a disabled Load more button. Strengthen those same catalog states and declare the shared inline loading mode.
Record 7253965385aa294beee4c1018fe7b231633d87ab35274a9a5367f37e29f7edba: nine cases fail visible view choices, history loading cue and inline placement; nine populated history cases pass.
Shared Select lists both views and shared LoadingState supports inline pagination status. Contracts declare the mode and source bindings; existing defaults remain.
